title: user.deleted
description: DEPRECATED account erasure signal. stapel-gdpr emits it alongside gdpr.erasure.requested for account subjects until its 0.6.0; since 0.6.0 this module consumes both through stapel_core.gdpr.register_gdpr_owner and routes them through one erase call (stapel_calendar.erasure.erase_subject), so the handler can be deleted without deleting any erasure logic. It receipts gdpr.section.erased only when the payload carried a correlation_id.
